summary: Added a diffusion HTTP protocol that compares live module parameters with checkpoint tensors after replaying the module's actual name mapping, dtype conversion, and custom fused-parameter weight loaders. The response reports per-module disk/server SHA-256 values and returns a conflict on mismatch. The existing update-weights integration test now requests parity for all modules after a full update and for targeted modules after a partial update.

tests.what_was_measured: Reproduced the original gap: hashing raw checkpoint Q/K/V names and tensors does not equal the loaded fused-QKV server checksum. Raw output: reports/j-2c4a640e8dd9/raw/failing_before_reproduction.txt

Four focused tests passed: renamed parameters, fused QKV reconstruction, exact parity, one-value corruption detection, empty-comparison rejection, and compatibility with materialized offload weights. Raw output: reports/j-2c4a640e8dd9/raw/focused_tests.txt
All repository formatting, lint, syntax, secret, and policy hooks applicable to the changed files passed.

On one AMD Instinct MI350X with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, loaded GPU values matched an independently specified CPU tensor bit-for-bit; disk/server checksums matched before and diverged after a single GPU value was changed. Raw output: reports/j-2c4a640e8dd9/raw/gpu_checksum_validation.txt

remaining_limitations: The large FLUX.2-klein and Qwen-Image model-pair integration suite was not run because those model weights were not prepared locally; model-specific VAE/text-encoder parity remains unverified on this node.

Tensor-parallel and DTensor multi-GPU parity were not exercised because the task permits one assigned GPU. The implementation uses each DTensor's public local shard for server hashing, but a custom loader that cannot operate on a CPU scratch parameter will return a precise per-module comparison error.
Comparison temporarily materializes CPU scratch tensors for checkpoint-represented parameters, so peak host memory can approach the size of the requested module.
No native code changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
